description: This file defines functions and types for managing configured bindings in a plugin-based system, including registry resolution, caching, and rule compilation.

classes.name: CompiledConfiguredBindingRegistry
classes.description: A registry mapping channels to their compiled configured bindings.

classes.name: CachedCompiledConfiguredBindingRegistry
classes.description: A cache entry containing registry version and the registry itself.

methods.name: resolveLoadedChannelPlugin
methods.description: Resolves a plugin for a given channel name.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredBindingAdapter
methods.description: Resolves the binding adapter for a channel, returning its provider and channel info.

methods.name: resolveBindingConversationId
methods.description: Extracts the conversation ID from a binding object.

methods.name: compileConfiguredBindingTarget
methods.description: Compiles a binding target reference using the provider.

methods.name: compileConfiguredBindingRule
methods.description: Creates a configured binding rule with associated metadata.

methods.name: pushCompiledRule
methods.description: Adds a compiled rule to the rules map for a channel.

methods.name: compileConfiguredBindingRegistry
methods.description: Builds a registry of all configured bindings from the configuration.
